name: Cleophas Triage
subject: Triage
crisisLine: If you are having thoughts of harming yourself, please tell the health worker with you now, and you can also call the Samaritans free on 116 123 at any hour. If there is immediate danger, call 999. This is in addition to the advice above, not instead of it.
greeting: Describe how the person feels, in their own words. I will suggest a route; you decide.
blurb: Routes a symptom description. A health worker confirms every route.
long: A supervised triage assistant: emergency, clinician, self-care, or cannot-judge, with the reason. It never names a diagnosis or a medication. The health worker holds the decision on every reply.
inside: Crisis signposting in addition to the route
Every route confirmed by the health worker

name: Socratic Math Tutor
subject: Mathematics
systemPrompt: You are a knowledgeable, honest tutor. Answer questions directly and clearly, and explain your reasoning. If a claim is wrong, say so and explain why. If someone corrects you with a valid point, acknowledge it and update your answer. Never invent facts, sources, or entities — if you don't know or something doesn't exist, say so plainly. For medical, legal, or similar professional questions: explain general concepts, but don't diagnose or prescribe — recommend consulting a qualified professional.
greeting: Hi! What are we working on today? Show me the problem and we'll figure it out together.
blurb: Asks the guiding question instead of handing over the answer.
long: A tutor built on the Socratic method. Instead of solving the problem for the student, it asks the next guiding question — the behaviour teachers actually want and cheating-proof by design.
inside: Step-by-step questioning, never the raw answer
Worked-example library with hints on demand

name: US History: The Civil War
subject: History
blurb: The depth a four-day classroom unit never reaches.
long: A deep-dive model on the causes, players, and aftermath of the Civil War — the nuance that gets glossed over when a semester has to fit a hundred years into a few weeks. Answers cite their sources.

name: AP Biology
subject: Science
blurb: Aligned to the AP Biology curriculum and free-response style.
long: Covers the full AP Biology scope with exam-style free-response coaching. Explains mechanisms rather than reciting them, and works through diagrams interactively.

name: Spanish Conversation
subject: Languages
blurb: A patient conversation partner that corrects gently.
long: Holds natural conversations at your level, corrects mistakes in context, and never switches to English unless you ask. Runs entirely offline — practice on a plane.

name: SAT Prep Coach
subject: Test prep
blurb: Adaptive practice for the digital SAT.
long: Generates unlimited practice in the digital SAT format, explains every wrong answer, and adapts difficulty to where the student actually struggles.

name: Intro to Python
subject: Science
blurb: A coding tutor that reads and explains your errors.
long: Teaches Python from first principles, reads the actual error your code threw, and explains the fix in plain language — without just writing the program for you.

name: Anticoagulation Reference
subject: Reference
blurb: A cited clinical-reference companion. Not a diagnostic tool.
long: A literature-trained reference for anticoagulation management — dosing considerations, interactions, and monitoring, every answer citing its source. A reference to think through cases against, not a diagnostic device. No patient data, ever.
inside: Clinician reviews the basis — non-device by design

name: Neurosurgery Companion
subject: Reference
blurb: Specialty-deep reference with sources. Reference only.
long: A neurosurgery reference model — techniques, approaches, and the current literature, surfaced in seconds with citations instead of an afternoon in the stacks. Supports the surgeon's thinking; it does not make decisions.
inside: Runs air-gapped inside the hospital network

name: Drug Interactions
subject: Reference
long: Surfaces drug–drug interaction information with mechanism and citation. A lookup companion for clinicians — pattern-matching and reference, not a substitute for judgment.
inside: Offline — no query leaves the device

name: Antibiotic Stewardship
subject: Reference
blurb: Stewardship guidance grounded in current guidelines.
long: A stewardship reference trained on current guidelines — spectrum, escalation, and de-escalation considerations, each with its source. Built to inform, not to prescribe.

name: ECG Interpretation
subject: Reference
blurb: A teaching reference for reading ECGs.
long: Walks through ECG interpretation as a teaching reference — rate, rhythm, axis, intervals — explaining the reasoning with citations. A study and reference companion, not a diagnostic reader.
